note: The games Classic Cart Studio hosts and includes because each author's published license or written grant allows it (each record quotes its license and the uses it covers). Each game file is the author's own exact build, unchanged; where the license asks for it, its source is beside it. Classic Cart Studio supplies no original commercial NES game. known_builds lists builds Classic Cart Studio can recognize by their exact content (for example a full game its author sells) without hosting them.

games.description: Defend the villages of Thwaite from falling missiles: aim and fire your own to burst them in the air, alone or with a friend. An original game by Damian Yerrick in the style of the arcade classic Missile Command.
